where: The Coldfog cluster — the drained marches, the snuffed beacon and the Hollowfen stillworks
mood: Snuffed — a drained marsh where the lanterns went out; a lone melody that keeps reaching for home and guttering before it gets there.
core_styles: lone slightly detuned pulse-wave lead with a faltering melody that trails off into rests
cold thin string pad like mist
low slow synth bass holding long roots
faint irregular water drips instead of a beat
drained misty marsh where the lights went out, hollow, grieving and uneasy but never violent

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a quiet entrance into the fog: a cold string chord breathes in, one drip echoes, a low bass root settles underneath}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the lone lead plays a simple rising phrase reaching for home, then falters and trails off into silence before it resolves; memorable and sad}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same phrase again, answered by a faint far-off bell like a lantern that will not light, the mist pad slightly fuller}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: down to D minor, the lead drops low and still, long held notes over a single ominous bass root, the drips the only movement, then the mist swells back toward the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the reaching phrase returns, guttering again; the last bar drifts straight back into the theme, unresolved, no ending}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
